description.value: 101 Canada Boba is a Metro Vancouver bubble tea chain founded in 2020, specializing in grab-and-go fruit teas, milk teas, and seasonal specialty drinks made with premium ingredients sourced predominantly from Taiwan. The Cambie Street location is one of six BC stores in a rapidly expanding Canadian brand built around a streamlined, fast-service model. Cyclists passing through the Cambie corridor will find a quick refreshment stop with indoor seating but a strictly beverage-focused menu.
